name: date-range-picker
purpose: A time range for queries over time: logs, events, traces and metrics. After the Console Kit date-time range (quick ranges, absolute range with times, previous and next) and Cloudscape's date range picker. The value is either **relative** (`{ type: 'relative', amount: 15, unit: 'minute' }`, read as "the last 15 minutes" and re-resolved against the clock on every query, so a live view keeps moving) or **absolute** (`{ type: 'absolute', start, end }`, two ISO 8601 instants). The trigger prints `Last 15 minutes` or the absolute range in the selected time zone with its UTC offset. The panel switches between Relative range (the quick ranges and a custom duration) and Absolute range (the `Calendar` month grid, start and end date and time fields, and the time zone selector) and commits only on Apply; Cancel and Escape drop the draft. Absolute boundaries are typed as wall-clock time in the selected zone and stored as instants, so the same value reads correctly in every zone. With `showStep`, Previous and Next move the range by its own length. Date math uses `Intl` and the native `Date` only.
useWhen: Filtering events, logs, traces or metrics by time, where "the last N minutes" must stay relative.
Any range that needs times of day and a time zone, not only dates.
Investigations that page through time window by window (`show-step`).
avoidWhen: Picking whole days for a report or a billing period, with day presets → use `calendar`.
A single date or a date and time → use `calendar` with `mode="single"`.
A fixed list of named intervals and nothing custom → use `select` or `toggle-group`.
related: calendar` — the month grid, the date and time fields and the time zone selector come from it, so both pickers look and behave the same.
property-filter` — the query bar it sits next to in an events toolbar.
chart` — the histogram whose brush usually writes an absolute range back into this picker.
bestPractices: Keep relative values relative: resolve them to instants when the query runs (`now - amount × unit` to `now`), never when the user picks them.
Pass `now` in tests, demos and server-rendered pages so labels and step limits are deterministic.
Bind `v-model:time-zone` to the user's saved preference, and show times elsewhere on the page in the same zone.
Set `max` (usually now) and `min` (the retention limit) instead of validating after Apply.
Name the picker after what it filters (`aria-label="Events time range"`).

props.name: relativeOptions
props.doc: Quick ranges listed on the Relative tab.

props.name: timeZones
props.doc: Zones offered by the selector. Empty falls back to the zones `Intl` supports.

props.name: showTimeZone
props.doc: Shows the time zone selector in the panel.

props.name: showStep
props.doc: Shows Previous and Next buttons that move the range back or forward by its own length.

props.name: rangeSelectorMode
props.doc: Which kinds of range the panel offers.

props.name: min
props.doc: Earliest instant an absolute range may start at.

props.name: max
props.doc: Latest instant an absolute range may end at.

props.name: now
props.doc: Reference clock for relative ranges and stepping. Unset reads the real clock.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Trigger text with no range. Empty uses the locale catalog.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the trigger. Empty uses the locale catalog.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables the trigger and the step buttons.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size token of the trigger and the panel controls.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import DateRangePicker from '@aziontech/webkit/date-range-picker'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const range = ref({ type: 'relative', amount: 15, unit: 'minute', key: 'last-15-minutes' })
</script>

<template>
  <DateRangePicker
    v-model="range"
    aria-label="Events time range"
  />
</template>

examples.name: Absolute
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import DateRangePicker from '@aziontech/webkit/date-range-picker'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const range = ref({
    type: 'absolute',
    start: '2026-11-10T12:00:00.000Z',
    end: '2026-11-10T18:30:00.000Z'
  })
</script>

<template>
  <DateRangePicker
    v-model="range"
    range-selector-mode="absolute-only"
    time-zone="UTC"
    :max="new Date('2026-11-11T00:00:00.000Z')"
    aria-label="Billing window"
  />
</template>

examples.name: RelativeOnly
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import DateRangePicker from '@aziontech/webkit/date-range-picker'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const options = [
    { key: 'last-1-hour', amount: 1, unit: 'hour' },
    { key: 'last-24-hours', amount: 24, unit: 'hour' },
    { key: 'last-7-days', amount: 7, unit: 'day' },
    { key: 'last-30-days', amount: 30, unit: 'day' }
  ]

  const range = ref({ type: 'relative', amount: 24, unit: 'hour', key: 'last-24-hours' })
</script>

<template>
  <DateRangePicker
    v-model="range"
    :relative-options="options"
    range-selector-mode="relative-only"
    aria-label="Metrics interval"
  />
</template>
